text:
Zoe (Marketing): quick production ask for launch + webinar slides 111 Need a reproducible 10k stratified bench that focuses on tail latency and multilingual failure modes. Buckets: <32, 32-256, 256-1024, >1024. Langs: en, es, zh, ar, other. Run both rwd-7b-v1 (fp32) and rwd-7b-q4_0_v2 (q4_0). Outputs: per-slice p50/p90/p99, token-cost, failure-rate, and raw traces. Repro seed: 10101. Can runtime run this and share run command + artifacts by Tue EOD?

Jordan (Runtime): can do. couple clarifying q's: 1) warm vs cold separation? define warm how? 2) routing mix: production proportions or equal-per-lang? 3) concurrency sweep?

Zoe (Marketing): please separate warm/cold. define warm=warmup_tokens=3 and tag with header X-Bench-Warm=1. Use production routing proportions but ensure min 1k samples per language. Include concurrency sweep 4/8/16. Cap extreme sequences >8192 to avoid long queueing.

Mei (Eng): note: >1024 uses alternate kernel path and will materially change tail perf & cost. please emit kernel_path per request and prompt-length CDF. if zh fails concentrate, we may ask for a follow-up with zh warmup=8.

Jordan (Runtime): good notes. we'll emit CSV with fields: req_id, seed, lang, tok_count, warm_flag, latency_ms, token_cost, error_code, kernel_path. Will run concurrency variants and collect per-slice aggregates.

Sam (Ops): scheduling low-priority job on staging at 01:00 UTC tomorrow. example run commands i'll execute: 

./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-v1 --quant=fp32 --samples=10000 \
  --buckets="<32,32-256,256-1024,>1024" --langs="en,es,zh,ar,other" \
  --min_per_lang=1000 --warmup_tokens=3 --warm_header="X-Bench-Warm=1" \
  --concurrency=8 --batch=32 --cap=8192 --seed=10101 --tag=marketing-launch

./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-q4_0_v2 --quant=q4_0 --same-flags
I'll post job ids when queued. :thumbsup:

runbot: Job queued -> job-20260308-451. est runtime ~5h. logs: https://ci/internal/job-20260308-451/logs

runbot: Job started -> job-20260308-451.

Jordan (Runtime): implementation detail: warm_flag will be set if header present OR warmup_tokens>0. we'll also output prompt_length_cdf and kernel_fallback_count in the aggregate. ok?

Zoe (Marketing): perfect. please upload artifacts to s3://redwood-bench/marketing/4950123456/ and ping when done. we'll need CSVs + tar of raw traces + a tiny summary for slide copy.

runbot: job-20260308-451 completed. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/marketing/4950123456/. quick first-pass: q4_0_v2 shows ~10% better p50 on <32 tokens, but regressed ~13% p99 on >1024. overall failure rate 0.28%, concentrated in zh long sequences. kernel_fallback_count: 34 (mostly zh tokenization). Attached per-slice CSVs and raw traces in the bucket.

Mei (Eng): saw stacktraces for a tokenization edgecase in zh; serialized stacks at the bucket. recommend a short zh-focused rerun with warmup_tokens=8 to test mitigation.

Zoe (Marketing): thanks team 111 this gives us what we need for launch claims and the webinar narrative. we'll review artifacts and request a zh follow-up if needed. :raised_hands:
